nodes.title: SG-8.4.3 quality gate: context.md module table, stack check and docs contract
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md is still the 71-line README-only text. Its Modules table lists README.md and .gitignore, and it contains UNKNOWN placeholders. docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts already export contextStackProblems, contextModuleProblems, STACK_TERMS, STALE_TEXT and REQUIRED_MODULE_PATHS. Desired behavior: the module and stack helpers return [] for the real file, and the comment-only edits already in the two lib files are kept. Why: this closes the SG-8.4.3 quality gate.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the real context.md, when contextModuleProblems runs with existsSync from the repo root, then it returns [].
- Given the real context.md, when contextStackProblems runs, then it returns [].
- Given docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts, when the diff is read, then it contains only comment changes and every exported symbol is unchanged.


## Scope
- In scope: context.md module table and stack check contracts
- In scope: comment-only justification in docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code
- Out of scope: gameplay changes
- Preserve: Every exported symbol in docsCheck.ts and contextDoc.ts
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0
- Preserve: No file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped
- backend/ is out of scope
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- The module and stack unit tests pass against the real context.md


## Clarifying questions
- None
